uv_policy.editable_source: Metric projection on raw semantic faces before edge modifiers; modifier-created UVs remain interpolated in the editable source
uv_policy.evaluated_export: Reproject each evaluated face using its dominant absolute normal axis; omit that axis and divide the other two source-local coordinates by unchanged material meters_per_tile_uv; then group by ownership/material
uv_policy.consequence: Bevel-face native UVs can differ from direct modifier-interpolated source UVs. Export normals and geometry are evaluated source values; independent expected-export corner comparison uses this declared projection.

details.design_identity: One reusable faceted small-goods case with detachable lid and nested divided carrier; repeated instances/states are not additional designs
details.closure: Lift-off cap seated on shell rim, locator skirt clearance. No operating latch, hinge, lock or sealing claim

lid.interpretation: Manual detached handling. Parked locator bottom reaches inspection support datum Z0; not a retained mechanism or solved dynamics

carrier.interpretation: Detached, externally held state; deliberately unsupported in handling pose
